evidenceCards.practicalMeaning: The harness can inspect a live Android screen and refuse an interactive action under read-only policy with an agent-readable denial.
A setup session can prepare an app, then a read-only agent session can inspect the business UI while policy blocks a state-changing Login action.
The narrow differentiation is not better tapping; it is a governance control plane for AI agents that should observe first and act only when policy allows it.

remainingProofGaps.whyItMatters: Developers need to see the path from safe refusal to approved retry, not just refusal.
remainingProofGaps.fastestProof: Add a real-device proof that denies Login under read-only, switches to an explicit approval profile, retries, and records both outcomes.

remainingProofGaps.whyItMatters: The value for AI agents increases when evidence can be pasted or summarized directly in code review and CI handoff.
remainingProofGaps.fastestProof: Generate a compact markdown/JSON summary suitable for PR comments from the existing evidence bundle.

remainingProofGaps.whyItMatters: Mobile teams will discount the project if the governance story is Android-only for too long.
remainingProofGaps.fastestProof: Create the smallest iOS simulator or real-device governed-control proof with matching policy-denial semantics.
